werewolfEvidence.role: implementation evidence for architecture validation, not generic mechanics authority

architectureAuthority: ADR-0002 for repository and solution architecture semantics
ADR-0043 v0.2.0 for concrete current repository topology, project boundaries, paths, project names, and dependency layout
authoritySummary.werewolfPrototypeAuthority: Reference baseline for current-slice package evidence only

notes: DR-0001 accepted Option B on 2026-08-03: ADR-0002 remains architecture-semantics authority; ADR-0043 v0.2.0 controls concrete topology. Where concrete topology statements conflict, ADR-0043 prevails.
DR-0002 accepted Option B on 2026-08-03: Rule Set completeness means complete declared release scope with explicit enforceable exclusions, not complete source-system implementation.
DR-0003 accepted Option B on 2026-08-03: one shared normative Rule Set lifecycle distinguishes package maturity, publication status, installation status, and runtime activation status.

DR-0004 accepted Option B on 2026-08-03: SPEC-0001 defines documentation prototype, package source, packaged artifact, and installed artifact roles; documentation prototypes are review and authoring evidence only and do not confer runtime, packaging, installation, Campaign-binding, promotion, or publication authority by repository presence.
Werewolf prototype evidence shows a declarative prototype can be integration-ready while not implementation-ready, promotion-ready, or publication-ready.
